name: Annie Brophy
role: Mingusville woman who married John Munro
bio: Annie Brophy of Mingusville visited Medora with her sister Mary in November 1884 and came down for a dance in March 1885. She married John Munro at the Catholic church in August 1885.

moments.label: Married John Munro at the Catholic church

mentions: Misses Mary and Annie Brophy return this evening to their home in Mingusville. We hope to see them here often.
Miss Annie Brophy came down from Mingusville to the dance Tuesday evening.
